name: Shunsuke Takeuchi
bio:
Shunsuke Takeuchi (武内 駿輔) was born on September 12, 1997, in Tokyo, Japan, and works as a voice actor.

He first became widely known as the Producer in THE iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls — a role that earned him the nickname "Takeuchi P" and made the most of his deep, resonant voice and distinct stage presence. Since then he has voiced Lovecraft in Bungo Stray Dogs, Einar in Vinland Saga, Makoto Suzuki in Tokyo Revengers and Type F in the film SPY x FAMILY CODE: White.

His low register suits hulking, imposing adult men. TMDB currently lists 107 credits.
